title: Drag tabs, restack stacks that fell behind
summary: Tabs drag to reorder or out into a new window, the stack view tells you when a stack has fallen behind its trunk and restacks it, and a PR's menu copies its link.

features.title: Drag tabs
features.body: Drag a tab to reorder it, or out of the window to open it in a new one, with a preview of the window it will open.

features.title: Restack a stack that fell behind
features.body: The stack view checks whether a stack still sits on the remote trunk and each branch on its parent. When not, a banner says how far behind it is, with a Restack button.

features.title: Copy a PR's link
features.body: A PR's right-click menu copies its link.
